title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Standard and Basic licensed devices in the Pro Management portal
summary: The briefing still says no rollout mechanics are documented, although Microsoft documents automatic device enrollment and the briefing itself reports it elsewhere. Narrow that statement to the specific licence-enforcement change; the licence-assignment path, Graph operation and roadmap facts are supported.

claims.claim: The portal supports Teams Rooms on Windows devices with Standard or Basic licences.
claims.quote: The Teams Rooms Pro Management portal now supports and enforces licenses for devices in Teams Rooms on Windows with a Standard or Basic license.
